text:
1. 2. 4

Khattiyasuttaṃ

14. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:

Khattiyo dipadaṃ seṭṭho balivaddo catuppadaṃ, 

Komārī7seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ yo ca puttāna pubbajoti. 

(Bhagavā:)

Sambuddho dipadaṃ seṭṭho ājānīyo catuppadaṃ, 

Sussūsā seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ yo ca puttānamassavoti.
